home.title: svelte-dialect: Svelte 5 i18n with MessageFormat 2
home.description: Small i18n library for Svelte 5 and SvelteKit with runes, MessageFormat 2, typed message keys, locale routing and translations loaded on demand.

setup.title: Set up i18n in SvelteKit or Svelte 5
setup.description: Install svelte-dialect, add handle and reroute, and translate your first page, in SvelteKit or in a plain Vite + Svelte app.

messages.title: MessageFormat 2 syntax: plurals, numbers, dates
messages.description: Writing translations in MessageFormat 2: placeholders, plurals, selectors, number, currency and date formatting, and what a broken message does.

sources.title: Lazy-loading translations in SvelteKit
sources.description: Bundle translations at build time, split them into per-namespace chunks, or load them from an API or a database through remote functions.

routing.title: SvelteKit locale routing: /de/about with reroute
routing.description: Put the locale in the URL without a [locale] folder: reroute, localizeHref, a base path, and prerendering every language.

strategy.title: Locale detection in SvelteKit: URL, cookie, header
strategy.description: The locale comes from the URL prefix, a cookie, Accept-Language or the browser language, in an order you can change, and each request keeps its own.

rich.title: Rich text translations in Svelte with snippets
rich.description: Links, bold text and components inside translated messages, rendered through Svelte snippets instead of raw HTML.

typed.title: Type-safe translation keys for Svelte: typegen and check
typed.description: Generate a union of message keys and their parameters, catch missing translations in CI, and convert i18next or ICU JSON to MessageFormat 2.

api.title: API reference: svelte-dialect
api.description: Every export of svelte-dialect and svelte-dialect/kit, and every createDialect option, in one table.

cli.title: svelte-dialect CLI reference: typegen, check, migrate
cli.description: Every command, flag and exit code of the svelte-dialect CLI: generate typed message keys, check translations in CI, convert i18next or ICU JSON to MessageFormat 2.

migrate.title: Migrate to MessageFormat 2 from svelte-i18n and i18next
migrate.description: Convert i18next and ICU MessageFormat JSON to MessageFormat 2 with one CLI command, then fix what the converter flags.

compare.title: Svelte i18n libraries compared (2026)
compare.description: svelte-i18n, Sveltia I18n, sveltekit-i18n, Paraglide, typesafe-i18n, wuchale and svelte-dialect side by side: runes, types, SSR, routing and message format.
